description: This Java class 'UtilProperties' provides utility methods for managing application properties, including loading, caching, and retrieving properties from various sources and formats (properties files, XML, resource bundles). It supports locale-specific properties, resource resolution, and custom XML formats, with caching mechanisms for efficiency.

classes.name: UtilResourceBundle
classes.description: Custom extension of ResourceBundle with caching and support for OFBiz-specific XML properties format.

classes.name: ExtendedProperties
classes.description: Extension of Properties class supporting OFBiz custom XML properties format.

methods.name: propertyValueEquals
methods.description: Compares a property value to a string for equality.

methods.name: propertyValueEqualsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Compares a property value to a string for equality ignoring case.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a property from a resource.

methods.name: createProperties
methods.description: Creates a Properties instance from a filename.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Loads Properties from a resource or URL.

methods.name: getResourceBundle
methods.description: Loads a ResourceBundle for a resource and locale.

methods.name: xmlToProperties
methods.description: Converts XML InputStream to Properties, supporting OFBiz-specific XML format.
